rules.coordinates: Image pixels in 1536x1024; target boxes are direction, not pixel guarantees.
rules.blocking: Matte neutral body, simplified fur/quill mass, distinct full-limb colors from attachment to paw.
rules.anatomy: Exactly two shoulder-connected forelegs and two pelvis-connected hindlegs per mammal. Animal-left/right, not screen-left/right. Occlusion is allowed; never invent a limb to expose four endpoints.
rules.acting: Natural animal posture; rabbits never run or stand like humans. No clothes, shoes, separate arms or human hands.
rules.review: Inspect blocking connections, gaze, overlap, scale and ground contact; only then finish textures. Recheck after finishing.
rules.render: Soft dimensional miniature hedgehog and rabbits, cream muzzle/chest, brown quills; small natural eyes and nose; no stray face dot, no golden head/back ornament.
rules.identity: PinPin compact low hedgehog; Lulu pale-gray rabbit with white muzzle and pink inner ears; Tawny smaller brown rabbit with cream chest and darker ear tips.
